macros.name: truncate
macros.doc: The package defines a command \truncate[ ⟨marker⟩ ]{ ⟨width⟩ }{ ⟨text⟩ }. If the text is too wide to fit in the specified width, then it is truncated, and a continuation marker is shown at the end.
